answer: Re-attestations are stored in yarrow and pigment lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the tundra graph. Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 20 epochs, so holding a position calls for ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm of 4018 identities would post 3071 proofs and burn roughly 59 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
